title: Human Epilepsy Genetics--Neuronal Migration Disorders Study
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to identify genes responsible for epilepsy, brain malformations and disorders of human cognition.
raw_criteria:
INCLUSION:

* Males and females of any age.
* Persons with a brain malformation or disorder of cognition (familial intellectual disability \[previously known as mental retardation\] or autism).

EXCLUSION:

* Persons without a brain malformation or disorder of cognition (familial intellectual disability (previously known as mental retardation\] or autism).
study_population: Participants will be selected through collaborations with clinicians.
